work:
Draft motifs. bridge, sea above a console belt. wet_lab, pipes over a grated floor. dry_lab, a wall of glowing screens. mess_hall, coffee under a pendant. medical_bay, an exam bed under a lamp. crew_quarters, a row of cabin doors. editing_room, a wall of screens behind a laptop. engineering_workshop, pipes and tools over a grated floor. thomas_blake, a tailored figure leaning back. sarah_morgan, a straight-backed figure with clasped hands. maya_chen, a forward lean and an open palm. daniel_reyes, a broad hunch over a rag. olivia_hart, a straight-backed figure with clasped hands. lucas_weber, a forward lean and a raised hand.

First comparison. The bridge, dry lab and editing room all read as broad bands of screens. I gave the bridge a sea horizon, the dry lab a square-on matrix and the editing room a diagonal foreground camera. The wet lab and workshop shared a low, crowded view of pipework. I raised the workshop's emphasis to full-height parts racks. The mess and infirmary shared an intimate lamp pool. I kept the pendant over the mess table and gave the infirmary broad ceiling light. Sarah and Olivia shared an upright outline and clasped hands. I put Sarah's hands behind her back and seated Olivia with her hands in view. Maya and Lucas shared a forward lean and an active hand. I kept Maya's open gesture and turned Lucas sideways with his hands in his pockets.

Second comparison. No room pair shares more than two axes. I checked the closest pairs at thumbnail scale. The bridge and quarters read as a wide sea band and a narrow corridor. The wet lab and mess read as looping hoses and a round table. The wet lab and workshop read as looping hoses and tall racks. The dry lab and quarters read as a monitor grid and receding doorways. The dry lab and editing room read as a level grid and a tilted foreground camera. The room layouts leave room for the ship's working fittings and wear. The closest portrait pairs share one axis at most. Thomas, Daniel and Lucas share the hip-up crop, with a tailored wedge, a hunched square and a sideways diagonal. Sarah and Maya share a waist-up crop, with a straight column and a forward arc. Maya and Olivia share soft light, with an open hand and tucked elbows.

rooms.description: A continuous strip of windows silhouettes a long navigation console against a blue-grey sea tilted by the roll. Radar and weather screens sit low beside a radio, a clipped logbook and a cork noticeboard.

From just above the anti-slip deck, teal seawater hoses loop across steel bench legs and feed two squat pumps. A work light picks out beads of condensation on sample bottles beneath a clamped sampling manifold.

From just above the chairs, face a flush two-by-three bank of monitors. Violet plots wash over bolted computer desks, squared stacks of pencilled diagrams and a single capped pen aligned with a keyboard.

At seated height, a round bolted table fills the frame beneath an orange pendant. Personal mugs, a coffee pot and crumbs catch the light. Beyond them, curled snapshots crowd the noticeboard beside a scuffed galley refrigerator.

The exam bed spans the doorway view, its pale green vinyl under diffuse ceiling panels. Flush cabinets with recessed latches line one wall. A diagnostic workstation and a narrow report desk share the far corner.
Four narrow cabin doors on each side converge on a blank bulkhead. A single ajar door spills soft yellow light across the opposite jamb, revealing rubbed paint, a bunk corner and a sock on its rail.

Look past an empty chair's shoulder and a camera laid diagonally across the old chart desk. Two small monitors and a laptop dimly light pinned frame sketches, tangled headphones and the red dots of docked batteries.

From a tight corner, look up stacked steel cubbies packed with bearings and spare housings. Two caged fixtures throw sharp shadows across tethered wrenches, an unfolded maintenance diagram, a terminal and a battered bench meter.

people.description: Broad shoulders taper to a narrow waist in a tailored charcoal jacket over a burgundy knit. He leans back, meeting the eye with a practiced smile, neat side part and a capped pen pinched upright.
people.feeling: Polished and personable, with impatience in reserve.

people.description: A tall, lean figure stands square in a navy uniform with a straight zip. Her weathered face and close-cropped silver hair catch the rim light. Squared elbows show her hands tucked behind her back.
people.feeling: Steady and protective, with every word considered.

people.description: Petite, with a round face and a loose black braid, she leans forward in a mustard cardigan under a lab coat. Her palm opens mid-explanation as tired eyes flick sideways toward the listener's reaction.
people.feeling: Engaged and generous, with fatigue held in check.

people.description: Stocky and thick-necked, he hunches over a rag, wiping grease from his knuckles. An amber work lamp pools across faded coveralls, heavy stubble and a flattened crop of dark hair above his lowered eyes.
people.feeling: Tired and matter-of-fact, at ease with a job in hand.

people.description: Soft light rounds her full cheeks and chin-length auburn bob. She sits with elbows tucked into a loose sage scrub top, hands folded just inside the lower edge, eyes turned toward the speaker off-frame.
people.feeling: Discreet and attentive, comfortable with a pause.

people.description: Long-limbed and narrow-faced, he turns sideways in a close-cut teal windbreaker, hands deep in its pockets, one shoulder tipped high. A monitor's glow catches his unruly curls and eyes lifting across the room.
people.feeling: Restless and sociable, ready to pick up a conversation.
